baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence خَلَقَ ... بِالْحَقِّ / يَشَأْ / يُذْهِبْكُمْ / يَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ ties cosmic creation to a conditional removal-and-arrival operation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Creation of the encompassing heaven-earth field in truth supplies the scale and warrant; will initiates the operation, the addressed plurality passes away, and another created plurality arrives with genuine newness.

activation_trace.role: Origination joins the first cosmic act to the prospective bringing of another created order.
Truth as reality-congruent stability makes the created frame, and the inference drawn from it, non-illusory.
Divine willing supplies the initiating condition that relates intention to the realized thing.
Passing and departure give يُذْهِبْكُمْ its removal phase.
Arrival supplies the positive second phase rather than leaving only absence.
New occurrence after a cut marks the arriving creation as discontinuous with what departs.

changed_reading.before: God can destroy the addressees and make other beings.
changed_reading.after: The ayah presents a two-phase sovereign substitution inside the same truth-founded cosmic field: an addressed order is made to pass, then a genuinely new created order is made to arrive.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَلَقَ and خَلْقٍ repeat around بِالْحَقِّ, while جَدِيدٍ closes the sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The measuring image within خلق and the firm-fitting image within حق make replacement resemble refabrication to a valid measure; جديد then marks a fresh form after severance, not an arbitrary duplicate.

activation_trace.role: Prior measuring and proportioning turn both occurrences of خلق into a design operation.
Firmly wrought weave or speech supplies an image of internally coherent construction.
Renewal after a cut supplies the transition from one measured form to another.

changed_reading.before: New creation means merely another set of creatures.
changed_reading.after: New creation is a fresh, truth-fitting configuration, measured and coherently made after the present configuration is cut off.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَلَمْ تَرَ opens an assertion about the unseen capacity to replace, while السَّمَاوَات and الأَرْض span the visible field.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative seeing formula recruits reflective judgment: the upper and lower totality is the displayed sign from which the reader infers a further capacity that is not itself presently seen.

activation_trace.role: The alerting and inquiry formula makes seeing an invitation to report what follows from the sign.
Reflection of the heart supplies the inferential rather than merely ocular mode.
What rises and overshadows supplies the upper bound of the displayed totality.
The lower field opposite heaven supplies the matching lower bound.
Reality-matching truth licenses the inference from the seen order to replacive power.

changed_reading.before: Have you not visually noticed that God created the world?
changed_reading.after: The question trains a judgment: apprehend the whole ordered field, then recognize in it the capacity for a further removal and re-creation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly sequences exit, failed expulsion, destruction, and settlement after the removed group. That sequence gives the focus substitution a social-spatial mechanism: one regime tries to eject the messengers, is itself removed, and another community is installed in its place.

activation_trace.role: Departure anchors the removal half of the focus sequence.
Arrival anchors the installation half of the focus sequence.
Bringing something out of concealment frames communal emergence from darkness.
Passage to the outside supplies the opponents' threatened territorial expulsion.
Falling into destruction reverses the expulsion threat onto the wrongdoers.
Dwelling in a home supplies the positive resettlement that follows removal.
The after-versus-before branch turns destruction and settlement into an ordered succession.

structural_cues: 14:13 threatens لَنُخْرِجَنَّكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِنَا, then promises لَنُهْلِكَنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ; 14:14 follows with لَنُسْكِنَنَّكُمُ الأَرْضَ مِن بَعْدِهِمْ.
The opening 14:1 already defines revelation as bringing people out from darkness into light.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exit, expulsion, destruction, and settlement-after; I infer a reversal arrow that instantiates يُذْهِبْكُمْ / يَأْتِ. A live alternative is total species replacement with no continuity of land or community.

changed_reading.before: The focus threatens an unspecified replacement of humanity.
changed_reading.after: The threat can be read as a concrete regime succession: failed expellers are removed and an emergent community is settled after them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, acquired works lose cohesion like ash under a scattering wind. The later paired tree models distinguish a rooted, stable form from one pulled out whole with no resting ground. New creation therefore gains a structural contrast: re-creation is not another aggregate but a form able to hold together, root, and persist.

activation_trace.role: Completed and balanced form anchors the focus in organized configuration.
Firm construction supplies the criterion by which the new form differs from dispersed matter.
Ash left by burning supplies matter whose prior organization has collapsed.
Moving air supplies the medium that separates the ash.
A severe wind that makes things light and scatters them supplies the de-cohesive force.
The trunked tree supplies an integrated living form.
Root and base supply attachment and ordered support.
Continuance and stability supply persistence through time.
Total extraction from the root supplies the inverse operation of stable creation.
Stability and settledness name what the uprooted form lacks.

structural_cues: 14:18's ash-and-wind image immediately precedes the focus.
14:24 repeats أَلَمْ تَرَ and presents a fixed-root tree; 14:26 presents an uprooted tree with no قرار.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispersed residue and opposed rooted/uprooted forms; I infer that cohesion is the arrow linking them to خلق جديد. The tree pair can alternatively remain limited to words or deeds rather than describe replacement itself.

changed_reading.before: Replacement changes which beings occupy the scene.
changed_reading.after: Replacement changes the quality of form: a dispersed, rootless aggregate gives way to a measured creation with internal coherence, attachment, and persistence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated seeing and reckoning formulas turn the focus opener into one station in a guided epistemic sequence: infer from creation, inspect an analogy, inspect historical substitution, reject the calculation of divine inattention, and finally see exposed outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Alerting inquiry anchors the focus as an instruction to attend and answer.
The repeated alert introduces the tree analogy as a second exercise in seeing relations.
The next alert directs perception toward historical exchange and ruin.
Reckoning as supposition names the mistaken judgment that delayed action means neglect.
Leaving something outside awareness supplies the false predicate denied of God.
Eyes held in sight supply the later forced disclosure that answers present miscalculation.
Direct sight of the exposed criminals closes the movement from inferential to manifest seeing.

structural_cues: أَلَمْ تَرَ recurs at 14:19, 14:24, and 14:28; لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ occurs at 14:42 and 14:47; وَتَرَى follows at 14:49.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a patterned sequence of seeing, false reckoning, and eventual sight; I infer that 14:19 initiates a pedagogy of judgment rather than recording an observation. It may alternatively be an ordinary rhetorical question without programmatic force.

changed_reading.before: أَلَمْ تَرَ simply asks whether creation is evident.
changed_reading.after: It opens a disciplined way of reading the surah: infer hidden replacive capacity from signs now, correct false temporal calculations, and anticipate a disclosure that will become visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Late context escalates the focus operation from replacing an addressed group to destabilizing apparently immovable features and exchanging the world-ground itself. Human removal and cosmic transformation become nested scales of one replacive power.

activation_trace.role: Passing away anchors personal or collective removal.
New occurrence after severance anchors discontinuity at the replacement endpoint.
Removal from place or state names the permanence the addressees had falsely claimed.
The same displacement image is applied to mountains and enlarges the scale of possible removal.
Elevated solid mass supplies the strongest local image of apparent immovability.
One thing standing in another's place states explicit substrate substitution.
Changing a form or replacing it with another sharpens the difference of the exchanged earth.
The lower world-ground appears on both sides of the exchange.
The overshadowing upper field joins the earth in the transformed cosmic frame.
Emergence into exposure places all persons before God after the substrate exchange.

structural_cues: 14:44 recalls the claim مَا لَكُم مِّن زَوَالٍ; 14:46 imagines mountains displaced; 14:48 states تُبَدَّلُ الأَرْضُ غَيْرَ الأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاوَاتُ.
14:48 reuses both cosmic poles named in 14:19.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies claimed permanence, mountain displacement, and explicit earth-heaven exchange; I infer that these retrospectively enlarge خلق جديد to world-scale transformation. The narrower alternative is that 14:48 is a separate event while 14:19 concerns only replacement of people.

changed_reading.before: God removes one human population and brings another within an unchanged world.
changed_reading.after: The human substitution is nested inside a larger possibility: even the apparently fixed heaven-earth substrate can be exchanged before all are exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Abraham sequence places descendants in a valley defined by absence of cultivation, then asks for attraction and fruit, and remembers sons gifted in old age. It activates خلق جديد as successor life arriving where ordinary continuation looks materially weak.

activation_trace.role: Origination anchors the successor generation as genuinely made rather than merely relocated.
Arrival anchors the appearance of successor life.
Smallness and spreading give ذرية a propagation image.
Otherness and negation mark the valley by what it lacks: cultivation.
Planting and growth supply the absent natural continuation against which descendants are placed.
A gift without exchange frames the sons' arrival as granted continuation.
Parents defined through birth place the prayer within an intergenerational line.

structural_cues: 14:37 combines descendants with a valley غَيْرِ ذِي زَرْعٍ; 14:39 names Ismail and Isaac as gifts عَلَى الْكِبَرِ; 14:40-41 extend prayer across descendants and parents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a lineage, a non-growing setting, gifted sons, and cross-generational prayer; I infer that these instantiate new creation as successor generation. The live alternative is that خلق جديد remains an unrelated collective or cosmic replacement.

changed_reading.before: New creation is an anonymous substitute population.
changed_reading.after: It can also be heard as generational succession: granted life propagates into a future community despite conditions that appear unable to sustain continuation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later promise, judgment, non-neglect, and recompense sequence specifies بِالْحَقِّ as morally consequential order. Removal and new creation are not sheer displays of capacity; they occur within a settlement in which acts remain counted and meet their due return.

activation_trace.role: Binding due and fixed entitlement open بِالْحَقِّ toward moral necessity.
The promise characterized by reality-matching truth contrasts with the deceiver's broken promise.
A decisive judgment supplies the point at which the moral order is settled.
Mistaken supposition names the inference that delayed settlement means absent settlement.
Neglect as leaving something outside awareness is explicitly denied.
A spoken promise that opens expectation supplies the guaranteed future action.
Returning an act with its recompense states the moral matching operation.
What each self acquired supplies the input to recompense.
Counting and accounting supply exact settlement rather than indiscriminate replacement.

structural_cues: 14:22 contrasts وَعْدَ الْحَقِّ with a broken promise; 14:42 denies divine غفلة; 14:47 denies promise-breaking; 14:51 recompenses every self for what it earned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies true promise, decisive judgment, denied neglect, earned acts, and recompense; I infer that these specify the directional content of بِالْحَقِّ. It may alternatively denote wise or real creation generally, without a specifically distributive sense in 14:19.

changed_reading.before: بِالْحَقِّ broadly says creation is real or purposeful.
changed_reading.after: It also places removal and renewal inside a non-neglectful moral accounting where promised outcomes match acquired acts.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant س م و to و س م mapping and agricultural branches to materialize خلق جديد. It remains anchored in the focus through heaven, fertile earth, the growth-yield branch of يأتي, and newness, while 14:32 repeats the creation formula before rain and fruit. Downstream prose should present it as a packet-activated regenerative analogy, not as a lexical replacement for the ordinary sense of خلق.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: السَّمَاوَات / الأَرْض / يَأْتِ / خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ can form a rain-ground-emergence-newness chain.

activation_trace.role: The first rain marking earth with vegetation turns the upper field into a renewal trigger.
Soft fertile ground supplies the receptive medium for renewed emergence.
The coming-forth of growth and yield lets يَأْتِ carry an emergent production image.
Renewed occurrence after a cut supplies the crop-cycle discontinuity.
Sending a thing down supplies the rainward transfer from heaven.
Delivering water by irrigation supplies the material mediator.
Ripe fruit supplies the visible new product of the mediated cycle.
Nourishing provision assigns the fruit a sustaining function.
Continuous habit supplies recurrence to the sun-moon system driving renewal.

changed_reading.before: The new creation arrives as a ready-made replacement body.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can be pictured as regenerative yield: the ordered upper field feeds receptive ground, from which a newly sustaining form comes forth after the old is cut away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the warning's communicative action as a secondary enactment of the replacement it announces. It stays anchored in أَلَمْ تَرَ, يَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ and in the surah's book-to-emergence and proclamation-to-warning frame. The packet never explicitly equates conversion with خلق جديد, so downstream prose should qualify this as a performative social activation rather than the primary referent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The directly addressed seeing formula and the bringing of a new creation occur inside a surah framed as a message that brings people out and warns them toward knowledge of oneness.

activation_trace.role: Alerting inquiry makes the focus utterance act upon its addressee.
Bringing or presenting something supplies a possible communicative means of producing the new collective.
Ordered letters and the written object identify the message instrument.
Bringing out of concealment gives the message a transformative social action.
Delivery of a message closes the surah by naming its communicative function.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the intended change in recipients.
Things united toward one direction supply the possible shape of a reconstituted collective.

changed_reading.before: The utterance only reports a future threat of replacement.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the warning also begins to enact a new human configuration by bringing hearers out, awakening them, and orienting them together toward divine oneness.

strongest_changes: The expulsion-destruction-settlement sequence turns abstract replacement into a social-spatial reversal.
Ash dispersal and the rooted/uprooted tree pair redefine new creation as coherent, stable form rather than a new aggregate.
The earth-heaven exchange in 14:48 expands the focus from population succession to nested world-substrate transformation.
True promise, denied neglect, and recompense sharpen بِالْحَقِّ into morally indexed settlement.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made 14:19 function simultaneously as a substitution mechanism and an epistemic hinge. Repeated seeing formulas, direct creation echoes, succession scenes, and the split-root rain-growth inventory opened distinct readings without forcing them into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 14:48 should control the scale of 14:19 or only provide a later, separate instance of replacement.
Whether the genealogical and regenerative readings are intended mechanisms or only productive material analogies.
How much continuity, if any, remains between the removed addressees and the new creation.
